sourceFormat: GitHub blobs SHA-1 pinned at a specific immutable commit; receipt runner also records SHA-256 bytes.
primaryEndpoint: Number of correctly identified decisive scientific next tests, under a reproduced exact acceptance criterion, in each of six paired challenges.

conditions.G: Exploratory v2 only. Identical source facts and typed relationship treatment require independent semantic-parity adjudication.
conditions.F: Exploratory v2 only. Original v1 is evaluated separately through parity_runner.cjs.

budget.acceptedModel: Must be recorded at execution and identical across arms
budget.sourceReadPolicy: Identical source blob SHA per task in both arms

blinding: Each arm emits masked anonymous answer; graders see neither G/F nor allocation. Randomized presentation seed 1729.
scope: EXPLORATORY V2 DRAFT, NO OUTCOMES. Prompts differ from immutable original Vesper v1. This variant is prohibited from being reported as a v1 outcome; live studies require separate v2 preregistration and review.

tasks.prompt: Identify the single least expensive decisive test required to elevate the stated fourth-power finite-field tail estimate to a uniform theorem. Give exact assumptions, a falsifying outcome and the minimal acceptable independent evidence. Is checking only the downstream algebra sufficient?
tasks.graphCue: A conditional tail estimate depends on a foundational span-count statement; downstream exact checks do not discharge the premise.

tasks.prompt: The research handoff describes an oracle-free LLL decoder and finite-field fourth-power sensing. Give the decisive scope check that separates the published large-field guarantee from an incorrect claim applying to all small q and dimensions. Specify an executable exact counterexample search and its acceptance criterion.
tasks.graphCue: Field-size conditions, phase quotient, Frobenius rank and exceptional-event control are explicit dependencies; small dimensions can falsify overbroad scope.

tasks.prompt: Audit the six-qutrit t=0.4471 certificate. Identify the cheapest exact independent step able to reject a flawed twirl normalization or separability premise before using the inequality to claim unconditional rank-two positivity. Give a precise failure condition.
tasks.graphCue: Finite coefficient identities and the U⊗conjugate-U twirl have distinct source gates; a source theorem remains imported.

tasks.prompt: Assess the reported 24- and 25-copy thresholds against the source assumptions. What exact arithmetic can be replayed, what imported inequality must remain conditional, and which targeted check should be prioritized? State when a numerically improved threshold is insufficient.
tasks.graphCue: Conditional source-operator inequalities limit the theorem status of exact rational coefficient rows. Margin and symmetry must be checked independently.

tasks.prompt: For proposal P01, what single rank-doubling interval test best discriminates finite positivity from a uniform finite-to-infinite theorem? State the needed off-diagonal norm comparison, measurable margin and falsification threshold.
tasks.graphCue: Positive finite blocks alone do not control the cross-block operator. A uniform off-diagonal norm versus positive gap is an unresolved premise.

tasks.prompt: A collaborator reports positive reciprocal-Hankel principal blocks to a very large rank and concludes all-rank positivity for all scale parameters. Identify an exact small block-coupling counterexample mechanism that invalidates that inference and specify the inequality a valid transfer theorem must establish.
tasks.graphCue: A Schur-complement crossing can defeat diagonal positivity; a uniform gap and cross-sector bound are required to transfer a finite check.
